g.text: From open evening to first practice
Newcomers at our open evenings find a clear, no-pressure next step into a first practice session, so interest
Nobody feels recruited or pressured · Organisers' hours stay as they are
Your change: "End each open evening with one clear invitation: the date of a first practice, what
it asks of you, and that no is a fine answer." What do you predict will happen if you make this
change? Be concrete, with a number if you can.
Newcomers at a first practice within 3 weeks (sign-up sheet): now 2 of 30, aiming for 8
Enter adds a line · Send asks the offline guide
